questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abundant
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Ample**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abundant"** means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example: **The garden was abundant with flowers in full bloom.
 
 
 
• **"Ample" **refers to enough or more than enough; plentiful. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **There is ample time to complete the assignment.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Abundant' **is **'Ample'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ample**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scarce **(दुर्लभ): Limited in quantity; not enough.

 
 
• **Example:** During the drought, water became scarce.
 
 
 
• **Barren **(बंजर ): Not productive; devoid of life.
 
 
• **Example: **The barren land could not support any crops.
 
 
 
• **Difficult** (कठिन): Needing much effort or skill to accomplish.
 
 
• **Example:** The exam was so difficult that many students failed.

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(O) as it was the last one of the evening

(P) the city bus was overcrowded

(Q) and this gave an opportunity

(R) to the pickpockets

(S) to try their skill
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **POQRS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "**P** the city bus was overcrowded", which introduces the main subject.
 
• Following it, "**O** as it was the last one of the evening" provides the reason for the overcrowding.
 
• **Q** and this gave an opportunity" continues, indicating the consequence of the overcrowding situation.
 
• **R** to the pickpockets" specifies who benefited from the opportunity created.
 
• **S** to try their skill" completes the sentence by explaining what the pickpockets did with the opportunity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **POQRS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (SRPOQ):** This option starts with "to try their skill to the pickpockets," which is an incomplete and incorrect beginning for the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (PSORQ):** This option follows a similar structure, but it disrupts the logical flow by placing "and this gave an opportunity" before explaining the overcrowding.
 
• **Option 4 (SROPQ):** This option starts with "to try their skill to the pickpockets" and then explains the overcrowding, which creates an illogical and fragmented sentence structure.

questions.question:

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Every student in the hostel decided to travel to Delhi to witness the Republic Day parade.*

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The meal was not prepared by us.

options.text: We had not prepare the meal.
We did not prepare the meal.
We did not preparing the meal.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The meal was not prepared by us."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "we" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was not prepared" to "did not prepare" (simple past active).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We did not prepare the meal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"We had not prepare the meal." – Incorrect verb form ("prepare" should be "prepared").
 
• **Option 3: **"We did not preparing the meal." – Incorrect verb form ("preparing" should be "prepare").
 
• **Option 4: **"We did prepare the meal." – Incorrect in negation context, does not match the negative structure of the original sentence.

questions.question:

The homework must be done by you.

• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the homework" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "must do" to "must be done" (modal verb passive).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You must do the homework."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 2: **"You do the homework." – Incorrect in conveying the necessity implied by "must".
 
• **Option 3: **"You will do the homework." – Incorrect future tense, does not match the modal verb "must".

• Following it, "**d"** has been of considerable importance" explains the significance of the use of animal research.
 
• **"e"** in the field of scientific and medical advancements" specifies the area where it has been important.
 
• **"b"** throughout the past century" provides the time frame during which it has been important.
 
• **"c"** and it continues to be used to understand many diseases" completes the sentence by explaining its ongoing usage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

Spreading awareness about the rights of the consumers and the relief open to them in case they __did not get their money’s worth __of goods and service has rightly been identified as the first priority.

options.text: do not get their money’s worth
did not getting their money’s worth
will not get their money’s worth

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**do not get their money’s worth**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"did not get"** is incorrect because the reporting clause is in present perfect tense ("has rightly been identified"), so the subordinate clause should remain in present tense.
 
• The correct substitution is **"do not get"**, which matches the present context and conveys an ongoing or possible situation.
 
• Additionally, "goods and service" should be corrected to **"goods and services"** for proper usage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Spreading awareness about the rights of the consumers and the relief open to them in case they **do not get their money’s worth of goods and services**__ has rightly been identified as the first priority."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "No substitution"** is incorrect because "did not get" mismatches the tense of the main clause.
 
• **Option 3: "did not getting"** is grammatically wrong; the verb form is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: "will not get"** is incorrect because it unnecessarily shifts the meaning to future tense, while the sentence is about present/ongoing situations.

• Following it, "**C"** They are mostly built on the mountain tops" specifies the typical locations of these observatories.
 
• **"D"** Telescopes are placed in the dome-shaped roof of the building" describes an important feature of observatories.
 
• **"A"** These can turn around to track stars with the rotation of Earth" explains the functionality of the telescopes within observatories.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

By this time next year / I will had graduated from college / and started my first job / in the field of marketing.

options.text: I will had graduated from college

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 4 i.e. this part of the sentence contains a grammatical error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "I will had graduated from college" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct construction for future perfect tense is "will have" plus the past participle of the verb. Therefore, it should be "I will have graduated from college".

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *By this time next year, I will have graduated from college and started my first job in the field of marketing.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The future perfect tense is used to describe an action that will be completed before a specified point in the future.
 
• The structure for the future perfect tense is: "will have" + [past participle].
